title: Deployment-Time Memorization in Foundation-Model Agents
title_zh: Foundation-Model Agents 中的部署时记忆化
abstract_en: Foundation-model agents are increasingly long-lived systems that remember users across interactions, making memorization an explicit deployment-time function rather than solely a property of model weights. Existing work addresses parametric memorization or audits fixed memory configurations, but does not characterize how memory-design choices jointly shape personalization utility, extraction risk, and deletion fidelity. We study this surface as deployment-time memorization, formulating agent memory as a privacy-utility frontier measured by Personalization Recall (PR) and Adversarial Extraction Rate (AER), and sweeping three memory-design knobs: summarization aggressiveness, retrieval breadth (k), and deletion mode. We further introduce the Forgetting Residue Score (FRS) to quantify whether deleted information remains recoverable from derived memory tiers. On LongMemEval, key-fact summarization reduces canary extraction by 76% on Gemma 3 12B and 64% on GPT-4o-mini while preserving nearly all personalization recall; critically, once content is compressed away, increasing k no longer restores leakage. The same compression, however, induces a deletion-fidelity failure: raw-only deletion leaves derived summary copies recoverable in approximately 20% of instances, and only full-pipeline purge or tombstone redaction drives worst-tier residue to zero. Together, these results establish that persistent agent memory must be evaluated as a first-class memorization mechanism -- assessed by what it helps agents recall, what it makes extractable, and what it can truly erase.
abstract_zh: 本文研究 Foundation-model agents 在部署阶段通过持久化记忆跨交互记住用户所带来的“部署时记忆化”（deployment-time memorization）问题。不同于仅关注模型权重中的参数化记忆，作者将 agent memory 视为隐私-效用前沿，并用 Personalization Recall（PR）衡量个性化效用、用 Adversarial Extraction Rate（AER）衡量可被攻击者抽取的风险，同时考察三类记忆设计旋钮：摘要压缩强度、检索宽度 k、删除模式。论文还提出 Forgetting Residue Score（FRS），用于量化删除信息是否仍可从派生记忆层中恢复。在 LongMemEval 上，key-fact summarization 在几乎保持个性化召回的同时，将 Gemma 3 12B 的 canary extraction 降低 76%，将 GPT-4o-mini 降低 64%；并且一旦敏感内容被压缩掉，增大 k 不会恢复泄漏。然而，同样的压缩也会导致删除保真度问题：仅删除 raw memory 时，派生 summary 中仍有约 20% 实例可恢复被删信息；只有 full-pipeline purge 或 tombstone redaction 能将最坏层级残留降为零。
key_points_zh: 提出“deployment-time memorization”视角，将持久化 agent memory 视为独立于模型参数的记忆化机制。
构建隐私-效用评估框架：用 Personalization Recall（PR）衡量个性化收益，用 Adversarial Extraction Rate（AER）衡量抽取风险。
系统扫描三类 memory-design knobs：summarization aggressiveness、retrieval breadth（k）和 deletion mode。
在 LongMemEval 上，key-fact summarization 显著降低 canary extraction，同时几乎不损害 personalization recall；压缩后增大 k 也难以恢复泄漏。
提出 Forgetting Residue Score（FRS）揭示删除失败：raw-only deletion 会在派生 summary 中留下残留，需 full-pipeline purge 或 tombstone redaction 才能彻底清除。

llm_assessment.comment: A timely study of persistent agent memory that provides practical privacy, utility, and deletion-fidelity evaluation concepts.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这项工作及时研究了持久化智能体记忆，并提出了实用的隐私、效用和删除保真度评估概念。
